# owner: platform
"""Seating charts: students sorted by last name, one text line per row."""

from typing import List

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


def _format_row(number: int, names: List[str]) -> str:
    return f"Row {number}: " + " | ".join(names)


# ---
def seat_rows(students: List[Student], seats: int) -> List[str]:
    """Return one line per row, students ordered by last name."""
    if seats < 1 or not students:
        raise ProjectError("need students and a positive seat count")
    ordered = sorted(students, key=lambda item: (item.last_name, item.first_name))
    names = [f"{item.last_name}, {item.first_name}" for item in ordered]
    chunks = [names[start:start + seats] for start in range(0, len(names), seats)]
    return [_format_row(index, chunk) for index, chunk in enumerate(chunks, 1)]
